rigi-sattel-lake-lucerne-balcony.title: Rigi · Sattel · Lake Lucerne Balcony
rigi-sattel-lake-lucerne-balcony.slogan: Short alpine views with a lake-road finish.
rigi-sattel-lake-lucerne-balcony.story: Short alpine views with a lake-road finish. 84 km round from Zug - plan on about 1 h 36 of riding. It goes by way of Rigi foothills view, Brunnen lake and Axenstrasse awareness section. The climb of the day is Sattel high road. It tops out at 1,100 m. It is a high-mountain day.

scenicChapters.title: Zug lakeside exit → Rigi foothills view
scenicChapters.narrative: The ground tilts up and stays tilted for 21 km. 687 m of it, taken steadily rather than in one wall. A steady rhythm suits this better than bursts. The height arrives whether you hurry or not.

scenicChapters.title: Lake Lucerne Axenstrasse
scenicChapters.narrative: This is where a day makes up time without anyone trying. Third and fourth, and very little else. 19 km that neither climbs nor drops much. The road settles into the ground rather than fighting it.

scenicChapters.title: Lake Lucerne Axenstrasse
scenicChapters.narrative: For 19 km this is Lake Lucerne Axenstrasse, a road with a name of its own and a reason for it — expect company on a summer weekend. Early is better than fast.
